VT-01.note: Role-bound BFF and gateway checks, trainer isolation, EN/FR Chromium route fixtures.

VT-02.note: Identity proof custody and provider test double. Integrated production identity is pending.

VT-03.note: Legacy continuation recovery and replay controls in current source regression. Cross-channel continuation is disabled.

VT-04.note: Current assessment/adverse source tests. Training fixture observations carry no clinical meaning.

VT-05.note: Worker confirmation and separate receiver profile within one durable fixture journey.

VT-06.note: Scoped consent, no receiver access to the source session, and transactional deny tests.

VT-07.note: Lost reply after storage, reconciling one dispatch before the separate partial decision.

VT-08.note: Ten sessions, eight queued, two occupied slots, lease and late-result fencing.

VT-09.note: Current combined route exercised with a fixture provider. Exact live worker-summary results remain predecessor evidence.

VT-10.note: Current negative policy and governance checks. No deployed policy transition was exercised.

VT-11.note: Audit faults roll back protected replay. Simulator audit is written atomically in its own store.

VT-12.note: Current signed transport and cross-audience tests. Deployed mesh, egress and process exclusion need candidate-specific proof.

VT-13.note: One-use export and unresolved delivery copy. Synthetic recording ciphertext expires in the active store. Independent copy handling retains residual obligations.

VT-14.note: Current journal fault and recovery regressions. Prior deployed-environment evidence retains its scope.

VT-15.note: Encrypted recovery and current-authority promotion regression in owned TLS PostgreSQL.

VT-16.note: Help, static fallback and outage regressions. No current combined topology dependency outage run.

VT-17.note: Local workload captured fixture first-use, reused and error timings. Need exact-model cold/warm and independent help at declared load.

VT-18.note: Current backend actor journey and routed browser accessibility in EN/FR. Matched fixture counts do not represent real actor benefit or independently reviewed outcomes.
